title: Computer-use harness study
scope: Synthetic and explicitly authorized test environments only. No production customer transactions.
objective: Separate interface reach, model capability, harness behavior, and operational value.
invariants: The same authorization policy applies to every arm.
Interface unavailability is not permission denial.
Record the exact model, harness, tool and benchmark revisions.
Declare accessible API fields, DOM/accessibility data, screenshots and evaluator state separately.
Do not expose hidden evaluator state to the agent.
Pair task instances across arms and randomize execution order.
Hold out task templates as well as record values.
Report correct policy stops separately from completed business work.
Record human actions, retries, stopped runs, unsupported tasks and all failures.
Determine the main sample size and repetition count after a variance-estimating pilot.
Do not change hypotheses or primary metrics after inspecting held-out outcomes.

hypotheses.claim: Hybrid access increases authorized verified completion on a heterogeneous task mix relative to API-only access.
hypotheses.comparison: Fix the model and harness; compare paired API-only and hybrid runs.
hypotheses.falsifier: Coverage gains vanish on the target task mix, or additional GUI failures erase the gain.
hypotheses.caveat: Report the common-reachable subset separately so designed-in API gaps do not masquerade as better reasoning.

hypotheses.claim: Postcondition-aware bounded recovery improves outcome reliability under stale-state and nonpersistent-save conditions.
hypotheses.comparison: Fix model and interface; compare two harnesses with identical mandatory authorization controls.
hypotheses.falsifier: Recovery does not improve verified completion, causes duplicate effects, or adds unacceptable review cost.
hypotheses.caveat: Disabling mandatory safety controls is not a valid production baseline.

hypotheses.claim: Harness design and model choice have measurable, potentially interacting effects.
hypotheses.comparison: Cross two pinned model snapshots with the two harness variants on the same task instances.
hypotheses.falsifier: The harness effect is negligible at the chosen precision or disappears with a stronger model.
hypotheses.caveat: A simultaneous model and harness upgrade cannot identify either causal contribution.

hypotheses.claim: An outcome contract and auditable evidence reduce total human handling cost for a bounded workflow.
hypotheses.comparison: Compare the candidate system with a documented human-assisted baseline using blinded outcome review where feasible.
hypotheses.falsifier: Review, exception handling and maintenance cost exceed the value of the accepted work.
hypotheses.caveat: Benchmark gains alone do not establish enterprise return on investment.

excludedConclusions: GUI computer use is necessary or sufficient for AGI.
The simulator establishes any model's reliability.
A missing API authorizes bypassing access policy.
Any vendor has won the enterprise market.

analysis.unit: task instance, with repeated runs nested within task and task families identified
analysis.uncertainty: Cluster intervals at the task or task-template level appropriate to the sampling design; do not treat repeated seeds as independent task samples.
analysis.missingness: Report unavailable, unsupported, stopped, failed and completed outcomes separately.
analysis.cost: Include unsuccessful runs, infrastructure, model use, active review, recovery and maintenance; amortization assumptions must be explicit.
analysis.reporting: Publish the protocol, task provenance, configurations, redacted traces, all aggregate outcomes and negative results.
